text: Being here fills me with curiosity. The contrast between the sterile, practical hallway and the colorful, vibrant R+D exhibit behind the glass inspires reflection. This is a space dedicated to research and rapid development, inviting thoughts about human innovation and how we progress as a society. I feel both slightly detached, separated by the glass, yet drawn in by the possibilities of what lies beyond. There is an undercurrent of anticipation, as if ideas are about to take shape and enact change.
